name: avista-activecollab
description: Create tasks, assign them to colleagues, set estimates, and log tracked hours in Avista's self-hosted ActiveCollab from Claude Code — a one-time token bootstrap that exchanges the 1Password-held login for an API token without ever storing the password, a pagination-aware `ac` API client, and approval-gated write skills that resolve projects, people and job types from names to IDs before posting.
